rationale: With the Chief Justice in the majority and emphasizing a narrow, institutionally modest path, John Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion and craft a Tornillo/Hurley compelled-carriage holding while leaving severable disclosure provisions for later analysis. Separate writings are most likely from Clarence Thomas (history/common-carrier limits) and Samuel Alito (PruneYard/common-carrier framing and caution), with occasional concurrences from others to stress severability or the speech/conduct line.
